name: pdfconverter
description: Aplikasi desktop modern berbasis Electron bergaya iLovePDF Suite untuk konversi Office ke PDF, manipulasi PDF (Merge, Split, Rotate, Watermark, Page Number, Images to PDF, dan PDF to Word) secara 100% offline — privasi terjamin tanpa server eksternal.

scripts.dev: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const p = require('child_process').spawn(require('electron'), ['.'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); p.on('close', process.exit);"
